description.en: Original Selkirkia-inspired static teaching animal: a slightly tapering unmineralized sheath has real wall thickness and two open ends. A continuous worm remains inside with radial clearance; only its anterior ring-toothed introvert and a small posterior end project beyond the openings. Sparse blunt ring teeth, color, size and posture are artistic, not exact count, calcium shell or locomotion claims.
description.zh: 原创Selkirkia启发静态教学动物：略渐细非矿化鞘管有真实壁厚及双端开口；连续虫体在管内留径向间隙，前部环齿吻和少量后端从开口伸出。稀疏钝齿、配色尺度姿态属美术概括，非精确计数/钙壳/运动机制。
